meta.textSample: CONTACT US GET STARTED FLICK TV PRICING COMMUNITY RESOURCES English About Flick — the team behind the AI filmmaking studio "We love filmmaking. That's why we created Flick — an AI tool designed for filmmakers to turn your wildest ideas into truly unique works. Here, AI doesn't replace your creativity; it listens, it follows. Without budget holding you back, let Flick help you set your imagination loose upon the world." — Co-Founders, Zoey & Ray Ray Wang Chief Executive/Technical Officer Ray was a founding engineer on the Instagram AI team. He helped build and launch the first version of Instagram Stories, and as the main backend contributor during its first year, wrote most of its core backend code—helping grow the product to 400M DAU by 2018. Zoey Zhang Chief Creative/Product Officer Zoey is an award-winning AI filmmaker and designer exploring the future of storytelling through human–AI co-creation. A graduate of Brown University × Rhode Island School of Design, she builds creative tools and cinematic worlds that bring human taste into the loop of AI. Mimi Chief Entertainment Officer A former stray cat adopted in 2021, Mimi has since been living a life of luxury. A proud graduate of the School of Hard Knocks, she now excels at entertaining founders and boosting team morale.
